action->Discorporate.name: Discorporate
action->Discorporate.description:
Desencadenante The ravener takes excess daño to their soul ward but still has at least 51 Puntos de Golpe in their soul ward

Efecto The ravener draws deeply into their soul ward, discorporating their body into soul energy in order to escape. They take 50 daño to their soul ward and their physical body vanishes, reappearing [[/r 1d4 #hours]]{1d4 hours} later in a random location within 1 mile from the location where they used Discorporate.

action->Redirect Fire.name: Redirect Fire
action->Redirect Fire.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within 100 pies casts a fire conjuro, or a fire conjuro otherwise comes into effect from a source within 100 pies

Efecto The ravener makes all the choices to determine the targets, destination, and other effects of the conjuro, as though they were the caster.

action->Soul Ward.name: Salvaguarda del alma
action->Soul Ward.description:
200 HP

An intangible field of necromantic energy protects a ravener from total destruction. A soul ward has 150 maximum Puntos de Golpe, or 200 if the ravener is level 21 or higher. Siempre que a ravener would be reduced below 1 Hit Point, all daño in excess of what would reduce them to 1 Hit Point is instead dealt to their soul ward. If this daño reduces the soul ward to fewer than 0 Puntos de Golpe, the ravener is destroyed. A soul ward's Puntos de Golpe can be restored only via specific ravener abilities such as Consume Soul, ravenous breath, or vicious criticals. A ravener who goes more than a week without successfully using Consume Soul to feed on a dying criatura starves, and their soul ward loses @Damage[1d4[healing]] Puntos de Golpe each day until they feed. If the ravener's soul ward loses all its Puntos de Golpe while the ravener still has more than 1 HP, they become a ravener husk.

action->Consume Soul.name: Consume Soul
action->Consume Soul.description:
DC 44

Desencadenante A living criatura within 30 pies of the ravener dies

Efecto The ravener tears the criatura's soul from its body with their maw and gulps it down. The dying criatura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:44] save with the same DC as the ravener's Breath Weapon.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The ravener tears off a small chunk of the criatura's soul. If the victim is restored to life, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} in addition to any other side effects of returning to life. The ravener adds a number of Puntos de Golpe to their soul ward equal to half the criatura's level.

Fallo As success, but the criatura's soul is ravaged. The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} and the ravener adds a number of Puntos de Golpe to their soul ward equal to the criatura's level.

Fallo crítico As failure, but the ravener devours the entire soul. The victim can't be restored to life as long as the ravener exists except via a 10th-rank effect such as miracle or wish, and the ravener adds a number of Puntos de Golpe to their soul ward equal to twice the criatura's level.

action->Manipulate Flames.name: Manipulate Flames
action->Manipulate Flames.description: The ravener attempts to take control of a magical fire or a fire conjuro within 100 pies. If it succeeds at a counteract check (counteract rank 10, counteract modifier +34), the original caster loses control of the conjuro or magical fire, control is transferred to the ravener, and this action counts as the ravener having Sustained the Spell with the action (if applicable). The ravener can elige to end the conjuro instead of taking control, if they elige.

action->Ravenous Breath Weapon.name: Ravenous Breath Weapon
action->Ravenous Breath Weapon.description:
The ravener breathes a blast of flame that deals @Damage[20d6[fire],4d6[persistent,void]|options:area-damage]{20d6 daño de fuego plus 4d6 daño persistente de vacío} (@Check[reflex|dc:44|basic|options:area-effect] save). A criatura that fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} on a critical failure). If a criatura is drained by the ravener's Ravenous Breath Weapon, the ravener's soul ward gains @Damage[5[healing]] HP.

The ravener can't use Breath Weapon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Vicious Criticals.name: Vicious Criticals
action->Vicious Criticals.description: The ravener treats an tirada de ataque as a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20, as long as the tirada de ataque was a success. Additionally, siempre que the ravener makes a critical hit with one of their Golpes, el objetivo must succeed on a @Check[fortitude|dc:42] save or gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} condition. If el objetivo already has a drained value of greater than 0, their drained value instead increases by 1, to a maximum of drained 4. Siempre que the ravener applies drain to a criatura in this way, their soul ward gains 5 Puntos de Golpe.

Ravener Husk.name: Ravener Husk
Ravener Husk.publicNotes: Raveners require a steady diet of souls, and a ravener that's unable to feed for too long eventually cannibalizes their own soul. Should a ravener's soul ward ever be reduced to 0 Puntos de Golpe by hunger while the ravener has more than 1 Hit Point (see Soul Ward), they lose all traces of their former identity and descend into a feral, nearly mindless state. Even if a ravener husk later consumes soul energy, the transformation can be reversed only via Ravenous Repast.

action->Soulsense.name: Soulsense
action->Soulsense.description: A ravener senses the spiritual essence of living and undead criaturas within the listed range. Las criaturas whose material bodies are one unit with their souls, like celestials and fiends, appear brighter to this sense.

action->Boneshatter.name: Boneshatter
action->Boneshatter.description:
Desencadenante The ravener husk takes any amount of daño contundente

Efecto The ravener's brittle bones shatter, spraying bone shards everywhere. Every criatura within a @Template[emanation|distance:10] of the ravener husk takes @Damage[7d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:31|basic|options:area-effect] save).

action->Frightful Presence.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.etMnv73EIdEZrYYu]

90 pies. @Check[will|dc:31]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.FrightfulPresence]

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
The ravener husk breathes a torrent of void energy that deals @Damage[16d6[void]|options:area-damage] daño in a @Template[cone|distance:40] (@Check[reflex|dc:34|basic|options:area-effect] save).

They can't use Breath Weapon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Ravenous Repast.name: Ravenous Repast
action->Ravenous Repast.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto The ravener husk makes a jaws Golpe against a deceased criatura that has been dead no longer than 1 minute, was good aligned, and was at least level 15 in life. The ravener attempts a @Check[flat|dc:5] check; if successful, they transform back into a ravener with 1 Hit Point in their soul ward.

action->Vicious Criticals.name: Vicious Criticals
action->Vicious Criticals.description: The ravener treats an tirada de ataque as a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20, as long as the tirada de ataque was a success. Additionally, siempre que the ravener makes a critical hit with one of their Golpes, el objetivo must succeed on a @Check[fortitude|dc:32] save or gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} condition. If el objetivo already has a drained value of greater than 0, their drained value instead increases by 1, to a maximum of drained 4. Siempre que the ravener applies drain to a criatura in this way, their soul ward gains 5 Puntos de Golpe.

Red Dracolisk.name: Red Dracolisk
Red Dracolisk.publicNotes: Dracolisks are rare magical crossbreeds of chromatic dragons and basilisks. None now know how they first came to be, but they have proven viable and can breed with one another as well as with basilisks. While a dracolisk appears much like a young true dragon of its parent type, its eight legs are an immediate indication that it is something more. Its coloration varies, depending on the NATURE of its draconic ancestry, though it's lighter on its underside and darker near its wing tips. A typical dracolisk is 15 pies long and weighs 3,000 pounds.

action->Tremorsense 30 feet.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.j2wsK6IsW5yMW1jW]
Tremorsense 30 pies

action->Draconic Resistance.name: Resistencia draconica
action->Draconic Resistance.description: A red dracolisk has resistance 10 to daño de fuego.

action->Petrifying Glance.name: Petrifying Glance
action->Petrifying Glance.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within 30 pies that the dracolisk can see starts its turn

Efecto El objetivo must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save. If it fails, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute as its body stiffens.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
The red dracolisk breathes a @Template[cone|distance:30] of energy. Este breath arma deals @Damage[6d10[fire]|options:area-damage] daño, with a @Check[reflex|dc:28|basic|options:area-effect] save.

The dracolisk can't use Breath Weapon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Petrifying Gaze.name: Petrifying Gaze
action->Petrifying Gaze.description:
The dracolisk stares at a criatura it can see within 30 pies. That criatura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:28] save. If it fails and has not already been ralentizado by Petrifying Glance or this ability, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}. If the criatura already was ralentizado by this ability or Petrifying Glance, a failed save causes the criatura to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified} permanently.

A criatura petrified in this manner can be instantly restored to flesh by being coated (not just splashed) with fresh dracolisk or basilisk blood no more than 1 hour old. A single dracolisk contains enough blood to coat [[/r 1d4+2 #Medium criaturas]] Medium criaturas in this manner.

action->Savage Jaws.name: Savage Jaws
action->Savage Jaws.description: The dracolisk makes a single Golpe with its jaws. If the attack hits, it deals @Damage[(4d12+16)[piercing]] daño (versatile S). Este counts as two attacks for its multiple attack penalización.

Reef Octopus.name: Reef Octopus
Reef Octopus.publicNotes: The common reef octopus is a risky but valuable catch for coastal fishers.

action->Camouflage.name: Camuflaje
action->Camouflage.description: The reef octopus can change the color of its skin to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} even if it doesn't have cover.

action->Ink Cloud.name: Ink Cloud
action->Ink Cloud.description:
The reef octopus emits a cloud of dark-brown ink in a @Template[emanation|distance:10]. Este cloud has no effect outside of water. Las criaturas inside the cloud are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido} and can't use their sense of smell. The cloud dissipates after 1 minute.

The octopus can't use Ink Cloud again for [[/br 2d6 #Recharge Ink Cloud]]{2d6 rounds}.

action->Jet.name: Chorro
action->Jet.description: The reef octopus moves up to 80 pies in a straight line through the water without triggering reactions.

action->Reef Octopus Venom.name: Reef Octopus Venom
action->Reef Octopus Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:17]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d4[poison]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] daño and Desprevenido (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[1d8[poison]] daño and Desprevenido (1 round)

action->Writhing Arms.name: Writhing Arms
action->Writhing Arms.description: The reef octopus makes up to four arm Golpes with different arms, each against a different target. Estos attacks count toward the octopus's multiple attack penalización, but the multiple attack penalización doesn't increase until after it makes all of its attacks.

Rusalka.name: Rusalka
Rusalka.publicNotes: Estos androgynous, river-dwelling fey delight in manipulating the emotions of those unfortunate enough to fall into their grasp, using humiliation to break their victims' wills. Rusalkas enjoy keeping their broken toys nearby, both for continuing entertainment and to aid in the rusalkas' defense, as the shame their captives feel often drives them to become obsessively loyal to these fey.

action->Beckoning Call.name: Beckoning Call
action->Beckoning Call.description:
The rusalka cries out a compelling invitation. Each non-fey criatura within a @Template[emanation|distance:300] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:27] save. The effect lasts for 1 round, but if the rusalka uses Beckoning Call again on subsequent rounds, the duration extends by 1 round for all affected criaturas. Once a criatura succeeds at any save against Beckoning Call, that criatura is temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Éxito The criatura is unaffected.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} and must spend each of its actions to move closer to the rusalka, avoiding obvious dangers. If a beckoned criatura is adjacent to the rusalka, it stays still and doesn't act. If attacked by the rusalka, the criatura is freed from captivation at the end of the rusalka's turn.

Fallo crítico As failure, but if attacked by the rusalka, the criatura can attempt a new save only at the start of its next turn, rather than being freed at the end of the rusalka's turn.

action->Constrict.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.g26YiEIfSHCpLocV]

@Damage[(2d8+10)[bludgeoning]], @Check[fortitude|dc:32|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Constrict]

action->Entangling Tresses.name: Entangling Tresses
action->Entangling Tresses.description: A rusalka can have up to eight criaturas grabbed within their tresses at a time.

action->Flowing Hair.name: Flowing Hair
action->Flowing Hair.description: The rusalka attempts an @Check[athletics] check against each @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} criatura's Fortitude DC. The rusalka moves each criatura they succeed against up to 10 pies and each criatura they critically succeed against up to 20 pies. Este movement must all be within reach of its tresses.

action->Shameful Touch.name: Shameful Touch
action->Shameful Touch.description:
The rusalka touches a criatura within 5 pies using their hand, stirring up memories of regret and shame. El objetivo must attempt a @Check[will|dc:35] save.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Fallo crítico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}, and it must use its first action on its next turn to Golpe itself, automatically hitting.

Sacristan.name: Sacristan
Sacristan.publicNotes: Sacristans are failures among the velstracs, criaturas whose bodies and minds have been utterly broken by the velstracs' torments. Estos unfortunates are assembled from scrap metal, nerveless flesh, and bits of darkness into loyal agents who take ecstatic pleasure in serving other velstracs. Sacristans are empowered by a miniature gateway to the Shadow Plane deep in their mouths. By distending their jaws, they can howl with the shrieks and windstorms of that plane. Sacristans vary in appearance but are the size of maimed humans. Their features are redundant or absent and they are wrapped in barbed and rusted chains.
Sacristan.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

action->Painsight.name: Painsight
action->Painsight.description: A velstrac automatically knows whether a criatura it sees has any of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded} conditions, as well as the value of those conditions

action->Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.lR9R5Vld8Eu2Dha5]
Regeneración 10 (Deactivated by Holy or Silver)

action->Staggering Servitude.name: Staggering Servitude
action->Staggering Servitude.description: 30 pies. When a criatura ends its turn in the aura, it sees a vision of the sacristan groveling in pitiable servitude. The criatura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:27] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

action->Focus Gaze.name: Focus Gaze
action->Focus Gaze.description: The sacristan stares at a criatura they can see within 30 pies. The criatura must immediately attempt a Will save against Staggering Servitude. In addition, if the criatura was already @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}, on a failed save its revulsion toward the sacristan's presence causes it to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute. After attempting this save, the criatura is then temporarily immune until the start of the sacristan's next turn.

action->Shadow Scream.name: Shadow Scream
action->Shadow Scream.description:
Frecuencia una vez por hora

Efecto The sacristan opens their mouth to unloose the wailing howls and mind-twisting darkness of the Shadow Plane. Este creates a @Template[emanation|distance:30] of darkness and wailing sounds around the sacristan. Las criaturas with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.qCCLZhnp2HhP3Ex6]{Darkvision} can't see through this darkness. The sacristan can Sustain Shadow Scream for up to 1 minute. Non-velstrac criaturas in the area when the ability is used, as well as those who enter or start their turn in the area, must attempt a @Check[will|dc:28|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:confused,inflicts:deafened] save.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected and is then temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} and deafened for 1 round.

Fallo crítico The criatura takes @Damage[20[mental]|options:area-damage] daño, and is confused and deafened for 1 round.

Sand Sentry.name: Sand Sentry
Sand Sentry.publicNotes: Shifting back and forth between a detailed likeness of a human and a muted and featureless bipedal form, this criatura of pure sand moves with an eerie grace. The sand sentry is often called upon by spellcasters to stand guard over an area of great importance-these elementals are patient participants in such roles, making them well suited for long-term service.

action->Tremorsense 60 feet.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.j2wsK6IsW5yMW1jW]
Tremorsense 60 pies

action->Glass Armor.name: Glass Armor
action->Glass Armor.description: When the sand sentry takes fire or lightning daño, its outer layer of sand fuses into sheets of hardened glass for 1 minute. Este increases the sand sentry's AC to 26 and grants it resistance 5 to acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, piercing, and daño cortante. A sand sentry can't use earth glide while glass armor is active.

action->Blinding Sand.name: Blinding Sand
action->Blinding Sand.description: When the sand sentry critically hits with a fist Golpe, el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

action->Earth Glide.name: Earth Glide
action->Earth Glide.description: A sand sentry can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H6v1VgowHaKHnVlG]{Burrow} through earthen matter, including rock. When it does so, it moves at its full burrow Velocidad, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.

Sandpoint Devil.name: Sandpoint Devil
Sandpoint Devil.publicNotes:
While some criaturas have been fused to create a new entity that's graceful and beautiful, the Sandpoint Devil is the opposite. It has the hooves and body of a powerful horse, but it walks on its hind legs in a perverse parody of a humanoid gait. Its equine face has been distorted and elongated with skeletal, yellowed fangs and milky eyes. The pox-spotted hide along the criatura's back bears a draconic tail with dark, spiny plates and two torn, bat-like wings.

The legendario Sandpoint Devil appears only on moonless nights when mists gather around the coast. Most encounters end with missing livestock or children, with little left behind other than oddly placed hoofprints that reek of brimstone.
Sandpoint Devil.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

Gust of Wind (At will)

spell->Produce Flame.name: Produce Flame
spell->Produce Flame.description:
A small ball of flame appears in the palm of tu hand, and tú lash out with it either in melee or at range. Make a conjuro tirada de ataque against tu target's AC. Este is normally a ranged attack, but puedes also make a melee attack against a criatura in tu unarmed reach.

On a success, tú deal 2d4 daño de fuego. On a critical success, el objetivo takes double daño and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,fire]] daño.

Heightened (+1) Increase the daño by 1d4 and the daño persistente on a critical hit by 1d4.

action->Accursed Breath.name: Accursed Breath
action->Accursed Breath.description:
The Sandpoint Devil breathes a @Template[cone|distance:30] of flame that deals @Damage[6d10[fire]|options:area-damage] daño. Each criatura in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:26|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:sickened] save.

The Sandpoint Devil can't use Accursed Breath for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Accursed Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura takes half daño.

Fallo The criatura takes full daño and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} by the agonizing pain of its burns.

Fallo crítico The criatura takes full daño and is cursed. The victim's flesh appears charred and burned, and the pain of being burned alive never fully vanishes. The cursed criatura takes a –2 penalización de estado to all checks from the constant pain. Healing doesn't alter the appearance of the burns or lessen the penalización, but removing the curse does.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.hjYNxH7BwkrzwVsE]{Efecto: Accursed Breath (Fallo crítico)}

action->Devil's Howl.name: Devil's Howl
action->Devil's Howl.description:
The Sandpoint Devil unleashes a bloodcurdling howl that can be heard for miles. Each criatura within a @Template[emanation|distance:100] must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:26] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 3} and fleeing as long as it remains asustado on a critical failure).

Las criaturas that attempt this Will save are then immune to Devil's Howl for 24 hours.

Sard.name: Sardo
Sard.publicNotes: An immense, gnarled, tree awoken with raw, primal power by one of the fey Eldest of the First World, this monster-one of the legendario Tane-skitters on huge, spidery roots and thrashes its branches as fiery lightning courses within its blackened bark, a living manifestation of the violent clash between ancient forest and stormy sky.

action->Planar Acclimation.name: Planar Acclimation
action->Planar Acclimation.description: The sard treats the plane it is located on as its home plane.

action->Splintering Death.name: Splintering Death
action->Splintering Death.description: When the sard dies, its body explodes in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. All criaturas in the area take @Damage[10d6[electricity],10d6[piercing]|options:area-damage]{10d6 daño de electricidad and 10d6 daño perforante} (@Check[reflex|dc:43|basic|options:area-effect] save). Any criatura that takes daño perforante is also exposed to sard venom.

action->Lightning-Struck Curse.name: Lightning-Struck Curse
action->Lightning-Struck Curse.description:
Desencadenante The sard is about to daño a criatura that has electricity resistance

Efecto An instant before el objetivo takes the daño de electricidad from the triggering event, the sard's electrical sparks glow red. El objetivo must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:41] save or lose any electricity resistance it has until this curse is lifted.

action->Sard Venom.name: Sard Venom
action->Sard Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:41]

Maximum Duration 10 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[2d6[electricity]] daño, @Damage[2d6[poison]] daño, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[3d6[electricity]] daño, @Damage[3d6[poison]] daño, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[4d6[electricity]] daño, @Damage[4d6[poison]] daño, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} (1 round)

action->Thorn Volley.name: Thorn Volley
action->Thorn Volley.description: The sard makes up to four thorn Golpes, each against a different target. The sard's multiple attack penalización doesn't increase until after all the attacks have been made.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.UNah0bxXxkcZjxO3]

Huge or smaller, root, @Check[reflex|dc:39|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

Sceaduinar.name: Sceaduinar
Sceaduinar.publicNotes:
Strange criaturas born from jagged crystals in the heart of the Void, sceaduinar are fueled by its void energy and driven to extinguish all life. Resembling crystalline gargoyles with serrated limbs and sharp, bat-like faces, sceaduinar stand about 7 pies tall and weigh around 100 pounds.

Estos malevolent beings sometimes gather in great packs of their own kind. Despite their INTELLIGENCE, they act like cunning, feral beasts for the most part, though they occasionally build tools to aid them in extinguishing life. Sceaduinar sail through the great voids of their home plane, seeking to destroy any sparks of life that find their way into that deadly realm-even the twisted sparks found in undead criaturas.

When they discover portals to other planes, sceaduinar swarm through in great numbers, slaughtering all they come across. While dwelling outside the Negative Energy plane is uncomfortable for sceaduinar, they can exist for extended periods of time apart from their home. Of course, the feeling of a plane where void energy isn't the rule doesn't improve these criaturas' attitude, and as a result, they tend to be particularly cruel and violent when encountered in such realms.

action->Void Child.name: Void Child
action->Void Child.description: Sceaduinars have neither souls nor the ability to create. A sceaduinar is immune to effects that target a soul (such as bind soul or resurrect) or that require knowledge of a criatura's identity (such as scrying), and critically fails CRAFTING checks.

action->Wing Flash.name: Wing Flash
action->Wing Flash.description:
Desencadenante A criatura attempts a melee attack against a sceaduinar or an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} the sceaduinar's space

Efecto The sceaduinar flexes its wings to emit a brief pulse of void energy that deals @Damage[4d6[void]] daño to the triggering criatura (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] save).

action->Drain Life.name: Drenar La Vida
action->Drain Life.description:
When the sceaduinar damages a living criatura with its jaws Golpe, the sceaduinar gains 5 Puntos de Golpe temporales and the criatura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:25|options:inflicts:drained] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Further daño dealt to the criatura by the sceaduinar increases the drained value by 1 on a failed save, to a maximum of drained 4.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.LRIYUFQ7FE9H4RWD]{Efecto: Drain Life}

action->Entropic Touch.name: Entropic Touch
action->Entropic Touch.description: Void daño dealt by a sceaduinar damages undead and criaturas with curación de vacío as if it were vitality daño. The sceaduinar's melee Golpes have the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch} property rune on attacks against incorporeal undead.

Scythe Tree.name: Scythe Tree
Scythe Tree.publicNotes:
Malevolent, vicious, and cruel, scythe trees pose as normal trees near deep forest paths, where they wait to slaughter passersby. Instead of drawing sustenance from light and soil, scythe trees gorge themselves on the flesh, blood, and bone of sapient criaturas. Nothing is more delectable to scythe trees than a kind-hearted gnome or an altruistic dryad who believes that a scythe tree can be redeemed. The screams and whimpers of these victims are music to these cruel plants and add an extra dimension of flavor to the meal.

Scythe trees are solitary criaturas by NATURE, and their size and power mean that they don't need to compete for food with other carnivorous plants. Once food sources dwindle in an area, scythe trees move on to another location. When a scythe tree dwells in a location for many months or years, it leaves traces of its bark and roots in the soil. Over time, these blood-nourished fragments might grow into a new scythe tree, but the progenitor will most likely have already moved on to new hunting grounds long before the new scythe tree reaches maturity.

Scythe trees appear as dead or dying deciduous trees with long, twisted branches that end in scythe-like blades. Estos carnivorous plants have dark-brown bark that is nearly black near the bottom of the trunk and rusty brown leaves that remain attached year-round. Scythe trees' disturbing mouths remain closed when not eating, appearing as a jagged gash on the trunk. When scythe trees deign to speak, their voices are rough, deep, and mocking, particularly when discussing arboreals, whom scythe trees universally find to be insufferable and worthy of little more than being hacked to pieces.

action->Dead Tree.name: Dead Tree
action->Dead Tree.description: Until the scythe tree acts, it appears to be a dead tree. It has an automatic result of 35 on DECEPTION checks and DCs to pass as a dead tree.

Efecto The scythe tree Strides up to 25 pies toward the triggering criatura. Once the criatura is in reach, the scythe tree makes a scythe branch Golpe against it. The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} against this Golpe.

Sea Drake.name: Sea Drake
Sea Drake.publicNotes:
Long and slender, sea drakes have fins down the length of their backs and webbing between their talons, making them just as adapted for gliding through ocean waves as the skies above. More solitary than most drakes, they hunt and live alone. Although most sea drakes make their roosts high on ocean-facing cliffs, it isn't unheard of for them to dwell in underwater caves, living entirely aquatic lives.

Distant cousins to dragons, drakes menace and terrorize settlements.

action->Electrified Blood.name: Electrified Blood
action->Electrified Blood.description:
Desencadenante An adjacent criatura deals piercing or daño cortante to the sea drake

Efecto An arc of electricity courses through the sea drake's blood. The triggering criatura takes @Damage[1d6[electricity]] daño.

action->Ball Lightning Breath.name: Ball Lightning Breath
action->Ball Lightning Breath.description:
The sea drake spews a ball of electricity that strikes a primary target within 100 pies, dealing @Damage[7d6[electricity]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic] save). The lightning then arcs to up to three secondary targets within 30 pies of the primary target, striking the closest available targets first. The secondary bolts each strike one secondary target and deal the same rolled daño value as the primary bolt (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] save).

The sea drake can't use Ball Lightning Breath again for [[/gmr 1d6 #Recharge Ball Lightning Breath]]{1d6 rounds}.

action->Briny Wound.name: Briny Wound
action->Briny Wound.description:
A sea drake's saliva carries a large quantity of salt, making its bite wounds even more painful. When a criatura takes daño from a sea drake's jaws Golpe, the criatura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save; the criatura is then temporarily immune to briny wound for 1 minute.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Fallo crítico The criatura is Sickened 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} as long as it's sickened.

action->Capsize.name: Capsize
action->Capsize.description: The drake tries to capsize an adjacent aquatic vessel of its size or smaller. The drake must succeed at an ATHLETICS check with a DC of 25 (reduced by 5 for each size smaller the vessel is than the drake) or the pilot's Sailing LORE DC, whichever is higher.

action->Draconic Frenzy.name: Frenesí Dracónico
action->Draconic Frenzy.description: The sea drake makes one jaws Golpe and two tail Golpes in any order.

action->Velocidad Surge.name: Velocidad Surge
action->Velocidad Surge.description:
Frecuencia tres veces al día

Efecto The sea drake Strides, Flies, or Swims twice.

Sea Snake.name: Sea Snake
Sea Snake.publicNotes: Estos lithe snakes like to frequent the shallow waters of tropical seas. Their 4-pies-long, blue-green bodies easily blend into the water where they lurk to ambush prey. Tales speak of massive sea snakes that swim in deeper waters and follow ships, waiting for sailors to fall overboard or climbing the side to snatch them from the deck.

action->Deep Breath.name: Contener La Respiración
action->Deep Breath.description: The sea snake can hold its breath for about an hour.

action->Lash Out.name: Lash Out
action->Lash Out.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within the sea snake's reach uses a move action

Efecto The sea snake makes a bite Golpe against the attacker.

action->Sea Snake Venom.name: Sea Snake Venom
action->Sea Snake Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:16]

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] daño (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Shadow Drake.name: Shadow Drake
Shadow Drake.publicNotes: Shadow drakes are typically among the smallest and least powerful of their species. Most stand as tall and long as house cats and have charcoal-colored scales and membranous wings just translucent enough to pass for shadows. Attracted to shiny materials, they employ DECEPTION, teamwork, and even rudimentary traps to create opportunities to make off with ill-gotten gains. Shadow drakes have a particular fascination and admiration for umbral dragons-a notable exception to the norm for drakes and dragons.

action->Shadow Blend.name: Shadow Blend
action->Shadow Blend.description: The shadow drake's form shifts and blends reflexively with surrounding shadows. A shadow drake gains an additional reaction each round, but it can use this reaction only for Shadow Evade.

action->Shadow Evade.name: Shadow Evade
action->Shadow Evade.description:
Desencadenante A criatura attacks the shadow drake while it is in an area of dim light

Efecto The shadow drake further obscures its position. The attacker must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:11] check in order to affect the shadow drake, as if the drake were @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido} for the triggering attack.

action->Draconic Frenzy.name: Frenesí Dracónico
action->Draconic Frenzy.description: The shadow drake makes one bite Golpe and two tail Golpes in any order.

action->Shadow Breath.name: Shadow Breath
action->Shadow Breath.description:
A shadow drake spits a ball of black liquid that explodes into a cloud of frigid black shadow. Este attack has a range of 40 pies and explodes in a @Template[burst|distance:5]{5-pies-radius burst}. Las criaturas within the burst take @Damage[3d6[cold]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic|options:area-effect] save). The explosion of shadow also snuffs out mundane light sources the size of a torch, lantern, or smaller, and attempts to counteract magical light with a [[/r 1d20+10 #Counteract Light]]{+10} counteract modifier.

The shadow drake can't use Shadow Breath again for [[/gmr 1d6 #Recharge Shadow Breath]] rounds.

action->Velocidad Surge.name: Velocidad Surge
action->Velocidad Surge.description:
Frecuencia tres veces al día

Efecto The shadow drake Strides or Flies twice.

Shoal Linnorm.name: Shoal Linnorm
Shoal Linnorm.publicNotes: Shoal linnorms occupy rocky shoreline shallows and slither along lonely coastlines. While they do not intentionally seek out large settlements, these linnorms nonetheless beleaguer fishers headed out from small coastal towns, and they may even follow skiffs back to their home port to appraise the town's defenses and plan a raid. Shoal linnorms tend to hunt large prey, both underwater and on land. Their preferred quarries includes giant squid and grizzly bears-meals rich in fat, which the linnorms metabolize into the fiery steam that courses through their veins.

action->Curse of Drowning.name: Curse of Drowning
action->Curse of Drowning.description: When a criatura slays a shoal linnorm, it must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:38] save or become cursed. As long as the curse of drowning persists, the character must spend 3 actions when drinking any liquid. Attempting to drink liquid faster causes the victim to begin drowning, immediately running out of air and falling unconscious.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description:
The shoal linnorm exhales scalding steam that deals @Damage[12d8[fire]|options:area-damage] daño in a @Template[cone|distance:60] (@Check[reflex|dc:36|basic|options:area-effect] save). The steam lingers until the end of the linnorm's next turn; anyone who enters the area or begins their turn in the area takes @Damage[6d8[fire]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:36|traits:damaging-effect] save negates). During this time, the steam is so thick that it impedes movement as well as sight, turning the area into difficult terrain. All criaturas in the steam become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto}, and all criaturas outside the steam become concealed to criaturas within it.

The shoal linnorm can't use Breath Weapon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Shoal Linnorm Venom.name: Shoal Linnorm Venom
action->Shoal Linnorm Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:36]

Maximum Duration 10 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[4d6[fire]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[6d6[fire]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 round).

Shocker Lizard.name: Shocker Lizard
Shocker Lizard.publicNotes:
Estos brightly colored reptiles share the rough size and pack mentality of guard dogs, roaming in small groups. Shocker lizards have specialized glands under their scales that accumulate static electricity, and they can unleash blasts of lightning strong enough to harm significantly larger foes. Though they're meek and docile when encountered alone, shocker lizards are significantly more aggressive in packs, when they can amplify each other's electrical attacks.

Shocker lizards are notoriously difficult to domesticate because they're dangerously hostile as part of a pack, but will also swiftly wither and die if kept alone in captivity without constant attention. A shocker lizard is 3 pies long and weighs 25 pounds.

action->Greater Electrolocation.name: Greater Electrolocation
action->Greater Electrolocation.description: A shocker lizard can sense minute electrical charges in living criaturas, which it can use as a precise sense at a range of 20 pies. Este distance increases to 100 pies against any criatura that has used an electricity effect within the last minute.

action->Amplify Voltage.name: Amplify Voltage
action->Amplify Voltage.description:
Desencadenante A shocker lizard within 20 pies makes a shock Golpe or uses Discharge

Efecto The shocker lizard lends some of its electrical power to the nearby lizard. Este either causes the other lizard's shock Golpe to lose the nonlethal rasgo or increases the DC of its Discharge to 20.

action->Discharge.name: Discharge
action->Discharge.description:
The shocker lizard releases a blast of lightning from its body. Las criaturas within a @Template[emanation|distance:10] take @Damage[3d6[electricity]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic|options:area-effect] save).

The shocker lizard can't use Discharge for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Discharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Shocking Burst.name: Shocking Burst
action->Shocking Burst.description:
The shocker lizard hunkers down and begins to spark with electricity, which it releases in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] that deals @Damage[3d8[electricity]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic|options:area-effect] save).

The shocker lizard can't use Shocking Burst again for 1 minute.

Up to four shocker lizards can combine their Shocking Bursts. In this case, the lizards can delay the release of their electricity until any other shocker lizard within 30 pies completes its Shocking Burst. The combined Shocking Bursts create an emanation with the combined area from all participating shocker lizards. For each additional shocker lizard that joins the burst, the daño increases by 3d8 and the save DC increases by 1 (to a maximum of four lizards dealing 12d8 daño with a DC 21 save).

Shoggti.name: Shoggti
Shoggti.publicNotes: Shoggti travel to other planes in roving bands to capture and charm victims, bringing them back to the Abyss where they are enslaved for unknown-but no doubt insidiously evil-purposes. Estos squid-like qlippoth have slick, blue skin and four suckered tentacles that end in dexterous pincers. In addition to a lamprey-like mouth at the base of its body, each has a secondary maw in the middle of its forehead that stretches from between its two bulging eyes to the back of its head.

action->Fascinating Display.description:
The shoggti writhes its tentacles and shifts its coloration to put on an unnaturally fascinating hypnotic display. Las criaturas in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save, after which they are temporarily immune to further Fascinating Displays for 1 minute.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} for 1 minute. Once the fascination effect ends, the criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Fallo crítico The criatura is fascinated for 1 minute, can't use reactions while fascinated, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} once the fascination ends.

Skaveling.name: Skaveling
Skaveling.publicNotes:
Hideous necromantic rituals give rise to skavelings, or ghoul bats, monstrosities that are not true ghouls but instead are specifically crafted undead criaturas. Their creators are the bloodsucking urdefhans of the Darklands, who create skavelings from giant bats specially raised on diets of toxic fungus and the flesh of ghouls-especially brains harvested from these undead. Upon reaching maturity, these giant bats are ritually slain via the use of cytillesh oil. While this poison simply rots away the flesh of most criaturas, one of these specially prepared bats will immediately rise from death as a skaveling after succumbing to its effects.

Despite its tattered wings and sagging skin, a skaveling is more than capable of flight, even when carrying a criatura mounted on its back-urdefhans often use skavelings as mounts in this way. Their INTELLIGENCE is more advanced than that of the typical giant bat, and in combat they function more as allies than as mere mounts, capable of making their own tactical decisions. Yet even though they can reason and think, skavelings remain loyal to the urdefhans who created them, and they never take actions in a fight that would knowingly put their masters in harm's way.

action->Echolocation.name: Ecolocalizacion
action->Echolocation.description: A skaveling can use its hearing as a precise sense at the listed range

action->Bone-Chilling Screech.name: Bone-Chilling Screech
action->Bone-Chilling Screech.description:
The skaveling unleashes a horrifying screech that chills the very bones of those close enough to feel it. The screech can be heard for miles, but each criatura in a @Template[emanation|distance:20] must also attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save.

The skaveling can't use Bone-Chilling Screech again for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Bone- Chilling Screech for 24 hours.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}.

Fallo crítico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} by fear.

action->Ghoul Fever.name: Ghoul Fever
action->Ghoul Fever.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:22]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d6[void]] daño and regains half as many Puntos de Golpe from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 @Damage[2d6[void]] daño and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a ghoul the next midnight

action->Paralysis.name: Paralysis
action->Paralysis.description:
Any criatura hit by the skaveling's Golpes must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each save.

Skrik Nettle.name: Skrik Nettle
Skrik Nettle.publicNotes:
The expansive skies of the First World are home to skrik nettles-delicate, bizarre-looking criaturas that resemble large jellyfishes. A fringe of brightly colored feathers circles their bodies, and long tendrils trail from their center, each ending in a snapping beak. Known for their eerie, chirping melodies, skrik nettles soar above the First World in flocks of a dozen or more, diligently scavenging for food in the fey realm's cutthroat ecosystem. When hunting or provoked, skrik nettles attack their foes by injecting them with a magical poison that causes the victim to float helplessly up into the sky. Skrik nettles continuously inject this poison into their helpless prey until it dies or is so high up that the skrik nettle needs only wait for the poison to end, its meal crashing helplessly to the ground below.

Skrik nettles that find their way to the Material Plane tend to be much more aggressive, for the planar energies that they find comforting and soothing on the First World are conspicuously absent. The first few minutes after a skrik nettle arrives on any plane but the First World tend to be filled with violence and fear, as the panicking criatura lashes out at any nearby criaturas in the mistaken notion that these others are somehow responsible for the discomforting change. After 10 minutes or so, assuming the skrik nettle survives its bout of violence, the criatura calms down somewhat and does its best to acclimate to its new home. Yet even skrik nettles who find themselves marooned beyond the First World for years never lose their longing for home, and they instinctively seek out portals to this plane for the rest of their lives.

action->Motionsense.name: Motionsense
action->Motionsense.description: A flying skrik nettle can detect the movement of nearby criaturas and objects from the tiny gusts of wind created by their movements. Este is a precise sense at the listed range, but it works only against criaturas and objects that moved through air in the previous round.

Skulk.name: Rondador
Skulk.publicNotes:
Los rondadores son cobardes y perezosos, viven al margen de las sociedades organizadas y roban a los demás sin pensárselo dos veces. Incluso el asesinato es una necesidad más para ellos y no dudan en entrar sigilosamente en una casa, matar a los residentes y llevarse lo que quieran.

Su capacidad camaleónica para mezclarse con el entorno hace que sean difíciles de detectar, por lo que sus poblaciones siempre presentes en la periferia de los grandes asentamientos son casi imposibles de desalojar de forma permanente. Suelen viajar en pequeños grupos de no más de dieciséis individuos, ya que los grupos más grandes tienden a disolverse debido a la violencia que surge entre ellos. Aunque los rondadores consideran que comparten un pasado común de ser expulsados y odiados, este vínculo no es lo suficientemente fuerte como para mantener a grandes grupos de estas criaturas unidos con un solo propósito durante mucho tiempo.

Las entradas y salidas de las ciudades, especialmente los accesos menos vigilados de las alcantarillas y similares, son sus lugares favoritos. Estos lugares les permiten observar de cerca quién entra y sale de la ciudad, a la vez que les ofrecen rápidas opciones de escape en caso de que las autoridades descubran su presencia. En raras ocasiones, un rondador bien disciplinado puede llegar a destacar en el gremio local de ladrones y ser solicitado para trabajos difíciles. Sin embargo, su repugnante personalidad y su abrumador egoísmo suelen impedir que consigan puestos de liderazgo duraderos.

Un rondador típico mide 6 pies (1,8 m) y tiene una estructura corporal similar a la de un humano desgarbado. Alcanzan la madurez rápidamente y pueden vivir hasta cincuenta años, aunque la mayoría encuentran un final violento mucho antes. Los raros rondadores que consiguen escapar de su sociedad de violencia y amargura pueden ser de cualquier alineamiento, pero los que permanecen vinculados a sus tradiciones siempre consideran a estos exiliados autoimpuestos traidores de la peor clase, y los exiliados suelen ser objetivo de erradicación, anteponiéndolos a todas las demás víctimas. Más de una banda de rondadores ha provocado accidentalmente su propia perdición después de renunciar a la cautela y exponer su existencia a las autoridades en un intento mal planeado, pero violentamente apasionado, de localizar a dicho exiliado.

action->Camouflaged Step.name: Pisada camuflada

action->Chameleon Skin.name: Piel camaleónica
action->Chameleon Skin.description: La piel del rondador cambia y se transforma para confundirse con el entorno. Mientras la mayor parte de su cuerpo no esté cubierta por ropa o armadura, el rondador obtiene un bonificador +2 por circunstancia a las pruebas de Sigilo para @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Esconderse}.

action->Sneak Attack.description: Los Golpes de un rondador infligen 1d6 de daño de precisión adicional a las criaturas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{desprevenidas}.

Slime Mold.name: Moho mucilaginoso
Slime Mold.publicNotes:
El moho mucilaginoso parece un montículo de tierra y detritus cubierto por una gruesa capa de hongos que desprende un leve olor a descomposición. En realidad, el hongo comparte una relación simbiótica con el moho mucilaginoso, que le sirve de sistema digestivo externo y le permite acceder a los nutrientes que necesita. El cieno permanece perfectamente inmóvil hasta que una presa viva pasa a su alcance y arremete con sus repugnantes pseudópodos. Con un toque, un moho mucilaginoso puede infectar a su presa con una horrible aflicción conocida como putridez mucilaginosa: una horrible enfermedad que descompone dolorosamente la carne de la víctima. Al principio, la enfermedad se manifiesta en forma de erupciones dolorosas y un agónico dolor en las articulaciones. Sin embargo, en las últimas fases, la carne de la criatura afectada empieza a licuarse y a escurrirse en hilillos de agua mientras las esporas de la criatura siguen actuando. La muerte, cuando se produce, provoca que el cadáver resultante se parta rápidamente por la mitad y libere un nuevo moho mucilaginoso.

Debido a sus extrañas estructuras físicas y a su capacidad para descomponer y alimentarse de gran variedad de materiales, los cienos son capaces de adaptarse a casi cualquier clima, especialmente cuando se les ayuda con magia o alquimia. Como resultado, los exploradores encuentran con frecuencia nuevas y aterradoras variedades de estas criaturas amorfas.

Solar.name: Solar
Solar.publicNotes:
Solars are among the greatest of all angels, ranking just below empyreal lords. Many solars serve at the right hand of a deity or champion a cause that benefits an entire world. Most archangels resemble humanoids, but not all-they can adopt more unusual forms as needed. A typical solar is about 9 pies tall and weighs about 500 pounds, with a commanding voice that is impossible to ignore. Most have silvery or golden skin.

Solars are legendario trackers; the most masterful of them are said to be able to follow the centuries-old passage of a pit fiend flying through the Astral Plane.

Angels are benevolent messengers who aid good forces in the fight against evil. Each angel has a special aura that assists in their individual tasks, and each angel delivers certain types of messages and performs other duties for the angelic hosts. While most angels live in the enlightened realm of Nirvana, some serve the forces of Heaven and Elysium, especially in the case of the angel empyreal lords within those two realms. Angels organize themselves into choirs depending on their ranks and roles.

A criatura that dies as a result of Drain Soul can't be restored to life except by a conjuro or ritual of 8th rank or higher. If the soul eater that used Drain Soul on a criatura is slain within 100 pies of that criatura's corpse and the criatura has been dead no longer than 1 minute, the criatura's soul returns to its body and is restored to life, leaving the criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} and dying 1 but no longer @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed}.

Este condition value decreases by 1 each time the criatura gets a full night's rest. As long as the criatura is stupefied by a soul eater, rest does not decrease any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} value that criatura might have.

Algunos elementales encarnan aspectos del aire como el humo, el rayo y la niebla.

El murciélago vuelve entonces a su forma normal en un espacio adyacente al metal. Este movimiento no provoca reacciones.

Specter.publicNotes:
Cuando una criatura maligna mortal muere, a veces vuelve a rondar la zona de su muerte como un espectro, un remanente detestable, que intenta constantemente matar a cualquiera (particularmente humanoides) en un intento de repartir su dolor entre tantas almas como le sea posible. Un espectro conserva un extraño parecido con su identidad anterior, pero con un sentido de propósito corrupto. No se puede razonar con él.

Un espectro al que se le niegue la oportunidad de dañar a los humanoides vivos sufre una agonía creciente y se vuelve irracional, similar a la mentalidad de una persona hambrienta a la que se le niega para siempre la liberación de su agonía a través de la muerte.

Spinosaurus.name: Spinosaurus
Spinosaurus.publicNotes:
The spinosaurus is more than just one of the largest carnivorous dinosaurs-it's also one of the most unusual in appearance, with a large, sail-like fin running along its spine. Often quite colorful, this sail allows the spinosaurus to attract mates, aids in swimming, and makes it appear to be even larger than it actually is. A swimming spinosaurus can also use the sail as part of a unique means of staggering prey by slapping the water with it to make a crushing wave.

The spinosaurus is equally at home in water as it is on land, and its long, toothy maw is well-adapted to catching swimming prey. Attempts by giants to capture spinosauruses to serve as guardians typically go poorly, for these headstrong dinosaurs do not domesticate well. Their surly attitudes and striking appearances make them better suited for bloodsports, and they are popular prizes for those who run arenas specializing in battles that pit gladiators against hungry animals or beasts. Of course, an angry dinosaur forced to fight for the amusement of others won't discriminate between potential meals on the battleground and ones seated in the surrounding stands.

The spinosaurus's appearance and strength make it attractive to more than just giants and bloodsport organizers. Spellcasters who mutate and transform animals into magical guardians have long been intrigued by the spinosaurus's potential. More so than any other dinosaurs, spinosauruses have been subjected to fleshwarping procedures, crossbreeding with monsters, and other magical techniques to enhance the criaturas' viability as effective guardians.

A spinosaurus can measure up to 60 pies in length and weighs 25,000 pounds.

action->Deep Breath.name: Contener La Respiración
action->Deep Breath.description: A spinosaurus can hold its breath for 2 hours.

action->Rip and Tear.name: Rasgar y despedazar
action->Rip and Tear.description:

Spiral Centurion.name: Spiral Centurion
Spiral Centurion.publicNotes:
Estos mechanical constructs were created to serve as guardians in an ancient and bygone era, although exactly who made them and the secrets of their construction have long since been lost to history. From the waist up, they resemble humanoids made of metal, but from the waist down their bodies take the form of spinning metal tops ringed with blades, which excel at cutting down nearby foes. Most spiral centurions can be directed to stand down with a password, although often these command phrases have been lost to the mists of time. In rare cases, a spiral centurion may also wield manufactured armas or a shield in addition to its built-in armas, giving it access to additional actions besides those listed below.

Most spiral centurions are hundreds or even thousands of years old, only staying functional because of the powerful magic used in their creation. Still, millennia of neglect have caused many spiral centurions to develop small glitches or malfunctions.

action->Top-Heavy.name: Top-Heavy
action->Top-Heavy.description: A spiral centurion's top-like design makes it susceptible to effects that would cause it to fall prone. The DC of any attempt to knock the spiral centurion @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} is reduced by 5. If the spiral centurion attempts a check or tirada de salvación to resist being knocked prone, it takes a -5 penalización de estado. A spiral centurion that has been knocked prone can't use any actions other than to attempt to Stand, but it must succeed at a @Check[acrobatics|dc:30] check to do so.

action->Hurl Blade.name: Hurl Blade
action->Hurl Blade.description:
The spiral centurion hurls one of its blades with an angled spin to ensure a swooping flight path. The blade deals @Damage[6d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] daño to each criatura in a @Template[line|distance:40] (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic|options:area-effect] save).

At the start of the spiral centurion's next turn, the blade swoops around and returns along the same flight path, again dealing 6d6 daño cortante (DC 30 basic Reflex save) to each criatura along the same line.

action->Rev Up.name: Rev Up
action->Rev Up.description:
Requisitos The spiral centurion has not acted yet this turn

Efecto The spiral centurion Strides up to its Velocidad. It then gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to attack and tiradas de daño until the end of its turn.

action->Trample.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.UNah0bxXxkcZjxO3]

Medium or smaller, blade, @Check[reflex|dc:30|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

action->Whirling Death.name: Whirling Death
action->Whirling Death.description: The spiral centurion spins furiously in place, its blades extended to slice through nearby criaturas. It makes up to five melee blade Golpes. No single criatura can be targeted by more than one blade Golpe during one use of this ability. Estos attacks count toward the spiral centurion's multiple attack penalización, but the multiple attack penalización doesn't increase until after all the attacks are made.

Spirit Naga.name: Naga espiritual
Spirit Naga.publicNotes:
En la cultura de las nagas, las malhumoradas y desaliñadas nagas espirituales ocupan un lugar despreciable similar al de las sagas en las culturas humanoides. Estas decrépitas criaturas viven en soledad y sólo las buscan aquellos que son lo suficientemente ingenuos o valientes como para pensar que pueden beneficiarse de sus poderes sin pagar un alto precio; para la mayoría de los que se atreven a mostrar tal arrogancia, el precio acaba siendo su propia vida.

Las nagas espirituales buscan ruinas desoladas y lugares asociados a la muerte y la corrupción desde hace mucho tiempo. Estos seres siniestros y serpentinos pueden encontrarse en bosques asolados, cementerios abandonados, fortalezas desmoronadas y pantanos en descomposición. Aunque no conocen la historia de estos lugares, se sienten atraídas por los restos psíquicos de las malas acciones y los espíritus atormentados que permanecen en latierra y las piedras.

A pesar de su horrible aspecto y de que las demás nagas las tratan como parias, las nagas espirituales se sienten profundamente orgullosas de sus habilidades e incluso de su existencia hermética. Se consideran conectadas a una fuerza mayor cuyos misterios sólo se revelan a aquellos que pueden desprenderse de las formas y la moral de la sociedad «civilizada». Aun así, aceptan alegremente la adoración de otras criaturas dispuestas a someterse a sus caprichosos antojos.

A menudo forman sectas a su alrededor, utilizando sus conjuros y rituales de hechizar para atrapar las mentes de unos pocos individuos clave que extiendan su infame influencia por toda la comunidad.

Las nagas son reconocibles por sus cuerpos serpentinos y sus extrañas cabezas de aspecto humano. Todas las nagas tienen capacidades mágicas y una gran inteligencia, que combinan para alcanzar sus objetivos.

spell->Inveigle.target: 1 criatura de un nivel no superior al doble del nivel del ritual de embaucamiento

action->Coven.description:
Una naga espiritual añade @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.U58aQWJ47VrI36yP]{Alucinación}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9BnhadUO8FMLmeZ3]{Sonda mental} y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwlh6aDgi86U3Q7H]{Sugestión} a sus conjuros de aquelarre.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Coven]

action->Spirit Naga Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:28]

Duración máxima 6 asaltos

Fase 1 @Damage[2d6[poison]]{2d6 de daño por veneno} y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} (1 asalto)

Fase 2 @Damage[2d6[poison]]{2d6 de daño por veneno} y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 2} (1 asalto)

Sportlebore Swarm.name: Sportlebore Swarm
Sportlebore Swarm.publicNotes: A swarm of sportlebores is a much more dangerous foe than a single insect.

action->Sportlebore Infestation.name: Sportlebore Infestation
action->Sportlebore Infestation.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:22]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 hour)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 hour)

Stage 4 @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] daño (@Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic] save) as the host painfully vomits out a sportlebore swarm and returns to stage 1

action->Pour Down Throat.name: Pour Down Throat
action->Pour Down Throat.description:
Desencadenante A criatura in the sportlebore swarm's area speaks, uses a verbal component, or opens its mouth

Efecto A portion of the sportlebore swarm attempts to surge down the throat of the triggering criatura, which must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:25|traits:damaging-effect] save.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura gets a mouthful of sportlebores. It spits the insects out and avoids further daño, but it no puede hablar for 1 round, and if it was performing a verbal spellcasting action, the conjuro fails and the caster wastes the action.

Fallo The criatura takes @Damage[4d6[piercing]] daño from sportlebore bites, no puede hablar for 1 round, and loses a conjuro as noted under Éxito.

Fallo crítico As failure, but the criatura is also exposed to sportlebore infestation.

action->Swarming Bites.name: Swarming Bites
action->Swarming Bites.description: Each criatura in the sportlebore swarm's area takes @Damage[4d6[piercing]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save).

Spriggan Bully.name: Spriggan Bully
Spriggan Bully.publicNotes: The typical spriggan is a bully who prefers to take live prisoners in fights, but only to ensure that they have a large stock of living victims to torment, tease, and abuse. They train to use armas in nonlethal ways that inflict the maximum amount of pain even as they guard against accidental death. When not bullying prisoners or hunting for new victims, spriggan bullies enjoy drinking, watching others fight, and fighting among themselves.

spell->Dancing Lights.name: Dancing Lights
spell->Dancing Lights.description: Creas up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 pies apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When tú Sustain the Spell, puedes move any number of lights up to 60 pies. Each light must remain within 120 pies of tú and within 10 pies of all others, or it winks out.

action->Enraged Growth.name: Enraged Growth
action->Enraged Growth.description:
Desencadenante The spriggan bully takes daño

Efecto The spriggan bully grows to Large size, along with their equipment (which returns to natural size if removed). The spriggan bully's reach increases by 5 pies. They regain @Damage[5[healing]] Puntos de Golpe and gain a +2 bonificador de estado to melee attacks and tiradas de daño. Este effect continues until the end of the spriggan bully's next turn, but on any turn in which the spriggan bully deals daño to another criatura and is not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}, the effect extends until the end of the following turn.

When Enraged Growth ends, the spriggan bully is fatigued for 1 hour.

action->Bully's Bludgeon.name: Bully's Bludgeon
action->Bully's Bludgeon.description: The spriggan bully makes a morningstar Golpe with a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to its tirada de ataque. Este attack is nonlethal.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

The spriggan bully's Golpes deal an additional 1d6 daño de precisión to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

Spriggan Warlord.name: Spriggan Warlord
Spriggan Warlord.publicNotes: While the leaders of larger spriggan enclaves tend to be uniquely entrenado warriors with highly specialized skills, spriggan warlords are fond of the traditional spriggan weaponry of morningstar and crossbow, valuing this traditional fighting style for its simplicity and for using both armas to their full potential. Spriggan warlords often serve as sub-commanders in large groups, filling roles in spriggan SOCIETY akin to captains of the guard or bodyguards to spriggan royalty. In smaller groups or remote outposts, a single spriggan warlord is typically in charge of a band of spriggan bullies.

action->Warlord's Training.name: Warlord's Training
action->Warlord's Training.description: Un caudillo spriggan tiene acceso a los efectos de especializacion critica de ballestas y luceros del alba, y la recarga de cualquier ballesta que empune se reduce en 1 (hasta un minimo de 0).

Star Archon.name: Star Archon
Star Archon.publicNotes: Embodiments of the virtue of prudence, star archons serve as philosophers and administrators, and in times of war as the tacticians, strategists, and generals of archon armies. Star archons burn with the glory and intensity of a sun, and their sense of duty and desire to defeat evil are as indefatigable as the light of the stars. While their dazzling intellects and unmatched strategic cunning make them most useful in war rooms rather than on battlefields, star archons are fierce opponents when motivated to enter the fray. Those who witness the self-sacrifice of a star archon and live to tell the tale describe the experience in terms that might befit the sight of a supernova at the instant the star collapses in on itself.
Star Archon.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

True Seeing (Constant)
